### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Triage 6450980372, verbatim: "Show the lock owner, and either wire Share to the sharing control or do not render it." / "⛔ No dead button." / "Re-check the landing site on current `main`." No maintainer ruling.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure; disproof welcome)

On `origin/main` `fd246c22` (a read-only check, not yet measured by you):
- The Share button is at `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` ≈L6090–6102, gated on `schema.sharing?.type`, with no `onClick` and no popover/dialog trigger (Print beside it ≈L6111 has one). `lockedBy` appears nowhere in `ListView.tsx`.
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.test.tsx` ≈L2572 is named "should display lockedBy in sharing tooltip when set" but asserts `title` = `Sharing: collaborative`; it pins the absence.
- `ViewSharingSchema` (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` ≈L1584) = `{ type: personal | collaborative, lockedBy?: string }`.
- No view-sharing control or endpoint was found: `ui/packages/components/src/share/ShareDialog.tsx` is the record share-link dialog, a different feature. If you find a real control, wiring it is the first branch of the ruling; otherwise the second branch applies.

### PM suggested route (optional; measurement wins)

Replace the dead `<Button>` with a non-interactive indicator (not a button role) that shows the sharing type and, when set, `lockedBy` (localized label through the plugin-list i18n default and `@object-ui/i18n` locales if new keys are needed). Fix the misnamed test, and add tests for `collaborative` + `lockedBy`, `personal`, and no `lockedBy`. Ablation: drop the `lockedBy` read (test red); restore the plain `<Button>` (role assertion red). Measure whether `lockedBy` is a user id or a display string, and say what you rendered.

### Scope

File surface: `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (the sharing toolbar region only), `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.test.tsx`, `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*` only if new strings, root `.changeset/` (`@object-ui/plugin-list` patch, `@object-ui/i18n` if touched). `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` ≈L146–152 cites the misnamed test as evidence that `sharing` is live: ⛔ do not edit `packages/spec/**`; report it under `out_of_scope_findings` with the line, and the seat routes it.
